nodes.description: OER stability at elevated temperature with MoO2-Ni heterostructure
nodes.source_text: MoO2-Ni-heterostructured nanowires grown on commercial nickel foam showed Pt-like HER activity at room temperature. Furthermore, its durability was evaluated at industrial temperatures. Remarkably, the catalyst could tolerate such harsh conditions for at least 115 h and still maintain its high catalytic activity at 51.9 °C.
